commands.command: rtk proxy node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path"),crypto=require("crypto"),assert=require("assert/strict"),yaml=require("./tutor-system/node_modules/js-yaml"); const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("evals/promptfoo/audits/tutor-v1-preparation-20260907/case-audit.json","utf8")),m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("evals/promptfoo/rubrics/v1/manifest.json","utf8")); const hash=p=>crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest("hex"); let assertions=0; const checkIds=[...m.checks,...m.retained_supporting_checks].map(c=>c.id).sort(); for(const s of [...a.sources,...m.sources])assert.equal(hash(s.path),s.sha256,s.path); const sourceCache=new Map(); for(const c of a.cases){if(!sourceCache.has(c.source.file))sourceCache.set(c.source.file,yaml.load(fs.readFileSync(c.source.file,"utf8"))); const original=sourceCache.get(c.source.file)[c.source.index];assert.deepEqual(c.source.vars,original.vars,c.case_id);assert.deepEqual(c.source.assertions,original.assert,c.case_id);assert.deepEqual(c.checks.map(c=>c.id).sort(),checkIds,c.case_id);assert.equal(c.legacy_assertion_review.length,original.assert.length);assert(c.legacy_assertion_review.every(r=>r.preserved&&r.disposition));assert.equal(c.provenance.holdout_eligible,false);assertions+=original.assert.length;} assert.equal(a.cases.length,43); assert.equal(new Set(a.cases.map(c=>c.case_id)).size,43); assert.equal(assertions,173);for(const q of a.review_questions)assert.deepEqual(q.case_ids,a.cases.filter(c=>c.review_question===q.id).map(c=>c.case_id));for(const c of m.checks)assert(fs.existsSync(path.join("evals/promptfoo/rubrics/v1",c.file)));console.log(JSON.stringify({cases:a.cases.length,assertions,checks_per_case:checkIds.length,source_and_manifest_hashes:"pass",original_inputs_and_assertions:"byte-content-equivalent parsed snapshots",legacy_assertion_dispositions:assertions,eligible_holdouts:0,review_groups:a.review_questions.length}));'
